messages:
anika: Heads-up — onboarding qv3-int4. Need to lock canary gating criteria before we push traffic. TL;DR: low latency but suspicious rerank regressions on longdocs.
harry: Where are we seeing regressions? sample slices?
liz: In longdoc-rr and code-summary slices. Small increase in hallucination rate (~1.8% on our test slices).
anika: exact numbers from eval run: avg MRR -2.6%, hallucination +1.8%, latency p99 -5ms. Thinking of gate: require no metric regressions >2% MRR or >1.5% halluc.
jamal: sounds reasonable. also add an automatic fallback if slice-wise delta exceeds 3% on any safety slice.
harry: I'd prefer composite rule: (global MRR drop >1.5% AND any safety slice >2.5%) -> rollback. Otherwise continue with 10% traffic ramp and 6-hour hold.
liz: propose config:
```json
{
  "canary": {"initial_pct":10, "ramp":10, "hold_hours":6},
  "rollback_if": [
    {"metric":"mrr","delta_pct":">-1.5"},
    {"metric":"hallucination_rate","delta_pct":">1.5","slice":"safety"}
  ],
  "slice_critical_threshold":3.0
}
```
anika: nice. also enable kv-warmup=true for longdocs and prefix cache.
jamal: add early abort: if difference in rerank-precision at top1 > 2.0 within first 1000 requests -> abort and route to fallback model v3.1-precise.
harry: agreed. I'll add that to rollout job. tag: @ml-ci-bot can you run a smoke shadow with these rules on staging? include 2M tokens.
ml-ci-bot: confirmed. kicked off shadow run 1717612345-rl-smoke-1. ETA ~45m. Will post pass/fail + per-slice diffs.
liz: also flag manual review for any hallucination uptick >1% from baseline — human-in-loop for first cut.
anika: perfect — if smoke looks good we'll plan promote tomorrow. Thanks all :thumbsup:
